<!--
Shared setup for the focused HowMaHiCo report templates (01_id_counts,
02_overlaps, 03_lcms_qc, 04_quant). Each focused skeleton pulls it in with a
knitr child chunk whose only option is
child = system.file("rmarkdown", "shared", "setup.Rmd", package = "HowMaHiCo").
(Do not paste that as a fenced r-chunk example in this comment: knitr parses
chunk headers even inside HTML comments, so an example fence would re-include
this file and duplicate the 'setup' chunk label.)

It loads libraries, derives the shortpep range / palettes / output folders, then
LOADS the cached `pep_all` (built once by build_pep_all() or by 00_mhc_report)
and derives `pep_short` plus the grouping vectors every section reuses. This is a
document fragment: it has no YAML header and runs in the parent's environment.
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
require("knitr")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
if (!is.null(params$ProjectDir) && nzchar(params$ProjectDir))
  knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(params$ProjectDir, mustWork = FALSE))
```

```{r initialize, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(HowMaHiCo)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggpubr)
library(viridis)
library(plotly)
library(openxlsx)
library(DT)

# handy settings
mhcclass_ranges <- list(MHC1 = c(8L, 13L), MHC2 = c(12L, 25L))
shortpep_range <- if (params$MHCclass %in% names(mhcclass_ranges)) {
  mhcclass_ranges[[params$MHCclass]]
} else {
  c(params$ShortPeptideLengthMin, params$ShortPeptideLengthMax)
}

mhcclass_palettes <- list(MHC1 = c("#fde725", "#440154"), MHC2 = c("#21918c", "#440154"))
shortpep_palette <- mhcclass_palettes[[if (params$MHCclass %in% names(mhcclass_palettes))
                                         params$MHCclass else "MHC1"]]
shortpep_colors <- setNames(shortpep_palette,
  c(paste0(shortpep_range[1], " to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs"), "others"))

if(params$Subset == ""){
  subset <- params$Subset
  FolderResults <- params$FolderResults
  FolderFigures <- params$FolderFigures
}else{
  subset <- paste0(params$Subset, "_")
  dir.create(file.path(params$FolderResults, params$Subset), showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(params$FolderFigures, params$Subset), showWarnings = FALSE)
  FolderResults <- file.path(params$FolderResults, params$Subset)
  FolderFigures <- file.path(params$FolderFigures, params$Subset)
}

file_rda <- file.path(params$FolderData, paste0(subset, "pep_all.rda"))

# pre-check to avoid overwriting prior outputs (the focused reports read, not
# write, the pep_all cache, so only the output folder is guarded here)
check_output_exists(params$FolderResults, overwrite = params$ResultsOverwrite)
```

```{r load-pep-all, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# pep_all source is selected by params$PepAllSource (default "cached"):
#   cached -> load the conventional <Subset>_pep_all.rda cache (file_rda)
#   rda    -> load an explicit .rda file given by params$PepAllFile
#   build  -> parse the raw search output via build_pep_all() and write the cache
.load_pep_all_rda <- function(path) {
  e <- new.env()
  load(path, envir = e)            # restores `pep_all`
  if (!exists("pep_all", envir = e))
    stop("'", path, "' does not contain a 'pep_all' object")
  e$pep_all
}
.pep_all_source <- if (is.null(params$PepAllSource) || !nzchar(params$PepAllSource))
  "cached" else params$PepAllSource

pep_all <- switch(.pep_all_source,
  cached = {
    if (!file.exists(file_rda))
      stop("pep_all cache not found at '", file_rda, "'.\n",
           "Build it first with build_pep_all(..., file_rda = '", file_rda, "'), ",
           "render 00_mhc_report (which writes the cache), or set ",
           "PepAllSource = 'build' to parse the raw results here.")
    .load_pep_all_rda(file_rda)
  },
  rda = {
    f <- params$PepAllFile
    if (is.null(f) || !nzchar(f) || !file.exists(f))
      stop("PepAllSource = 'rda' but PepAllFile '", f, "' was not found.")
    .load_pep_all_rda(f)
  },
  build = {
    annot <- read_annot(file.path(params$FolderDocumentation, params$AnnotationFile))
    build_pep_all(software = params$Software, folder_data = params$FolderData,
                  annotation = annot, shortpep_range = shortpep_range,
                  instrument = params$Instrument, test_mode = params$TestMode,
                  file_rda = file_rda)
  },
  stop("Unknown PepAllSource '", .pep_all_source, "'. Use 'cached', 'rda', or 'build'.")
)

pep_short <- pep_all |>
  filter(Length >= shortpep_range[1], Length <= shortpep_range[2])

# simplified info reused across sections
samples <- levels(pep_all$Sample)
conditions <- levels(pep_all$Condition)
n_conditions <- length(conditions)
bioreplicates <- levels(pep_all$BioReplicate)
comp_condition <- combn(conditions, 2) |> as.data.frame() |> as.list()

# facet layout reused by the size-distribution, RT/1k0/mz and motif sections
if (length(conditions) <= 3) {
  phis_nrow <- 1
  phis_ncol <- length(conditions)
} else {
  phis_nrow <- 3
  phis_ncol <- ceiling(length(conditions) / 3)
}
```
